title: WaSP: A Wavelet-based Semantically-guided Perceptual Metric for Image Super-Resolution (code)
description:
Code accompanying the paper WaSP: A Wavelet-based Semantically-guided Perceptual Metric for Image Super-Resolution (D. Kumar, G. Sikka, C.-C. Lin, S. Singh; submitted to Scientific Reports).

Contents: the WaSP metric (pip-installable), the super-resolution models and the two-phase fine-tuning code with the exact training recipes, every evaluation, analysis and figure script of the paper, and the per-image result caches the tables and figures were built from.

The code is released under the MIT license, except models/third_party/sinsr (SinSR / ResShift code, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial research use). Fine-tuned checkpoints are distributed separately.
